prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE flat children’s educational illustration, crisp shapes and simple solid colors. CACE N6: LLEÓ + PENTINAR + NINA + AMB + PINTA. Semantic focus: instrument. NO HUMAN FIGURES. Exact scene: LLEÓ: Les dents d’una pinta entren al cabell llarg de la nina; la nina sencera descansa sobre els genolls. Animal o criatura antropomòrfica amable; potes, ales o trompa adaptades al gest, amb anatomia recognoscible. L’eina actua sobre l’objecte; no està simplement al costat. Fons blanc sense escenari de lloc recognoscible; només base de suport imprescindible. Pure white seamless background. WIDE SHOT, camera far away: entire people or animals INCLUDING FEET, every target object and ALL furniture legs fully in frame. Scale the complete composition small to fit the CENTRAL 65 percent of the canvas; leave a WHITE BORDER at least 12 percent wide on ALL FOUR sides. Never crop lower legs or desk legs. One action in one instant, no sequence or collage. Only essential support. Friendly school material. Absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, brands, logos, watermark, arrows or speech bubbles, including clothing and books. Humans wear ordinary clothes. Hands/paws make clear functional contact. No identifiable room or landscape. Exactly the named living participants, no spectators, no family group, no additional people or animals. Vary human skin and hair naturally: dark brown skin, short curly hair. Do not add plants, carpets or decorative accessories not required by the scene. CORRECTION REQUIRED: NINA means a TOY DOLL, NOT a living human girl. Show only ONE living character, the friendly lion. The lion is seated and combs the long synthetic hair of a SMALL 30 cm rigid PLASTIC TOY DOLL lying sideways across his knees. Doll has visible plastic elbow and knee joints and small toy proportions. Whole doll visible including rigid toy feet. No real child. Comb teeth visibly in the toy doll hair. Exactly the target living participants only. No bystanders or extra family. Include feet, full furniture legs and all objects, scale the whole composition to the central 65 percent, leave at least a 12 percent empty white border on all FOUR sides. Wide distant view, never crop.
